entries.valueProposition: Agenda 3.0: desktop widget of date facts from PluginKit Time: the 1.x weekday/day/month, ISO week, day of year and days remaining, plus quarter, ISO week-year, days remaining in the month and a year-progress bar. No events: PluginKit has no calendar data source; On Hornero Signal the host owns the frame, position, size and edit mode (PluginKit 3 desktop widgets).
entries.nativeOverlap: Overlaps hornero-calendar on date display; distinct value is ISO week/week-year, day-of-year, remaining-day counts and year progress as labelled metrics.

accessibility.note: No interactive controls; the content root carries Accessible.name (static probe classifies non-interactive surfaces as na).

translation.note: All user-visible literals go through PluginKit Translations; es (Argentine Spanish) catalog declared in the manifest and checked complete for literal tr() strings (static probe). Weekday/month names and numbers are locale-formatted via Translations.

settings.note: Typed showIsoWeek/showDayOfYear/showYearProgress row toggles (boolean, default true) declared in the manifest and read via PluginKit Settings; defaults keep every 1.x row visible (static probe). The 2.x sizeClass/showOnDesktop settings are gone: the host owns size and position.
